facts.text: Bennington College has no required courses and no set majors; instead, each student designs an individualized course of study through The Plan Process.

sources.title: International Students Thrive at Bennington
sources.quote: In Bennington's open approach to education, there are no required courses and no set majors. Each student develops an individual course of study, together with a faculty advisor

facts.text: Every year, every Bennington College student spends six weeks in an off-campus work experience through the annual Field Work Term.

sources.title: International Students Thrive at Bennington
sources.quote: Every year, every Bennington student spends 6 weeks in an authentic off-campus work experience somewhere in the world.
